PRENATAL GENETIC TESTING REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Medical Record Number: [redacted ID]
Maternal Age: 38 years
Sample Type: Chorionic villi (uncultured)
Date of Collection: [redacted date]
Date of Report: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal screening for common trisomies via chorionic villus sampling (CVS)

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Chromosome-specific STR markers for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern
Markers tested: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742
Interpretation: Two copies detected

Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern  
Markers tested: D18S535, D18S391, D18S978
Interpretation: Two copies detected

Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern
Markers tested: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1270
Interpretation: Two copies detected

CONCLUSION
QF-PCR analysis shows normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. No evidence of trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), or trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) detected.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis from cultured chorionic villi to follow. This will provide comprehensive chromosomal analysis beyond the three chromosomes tested by QF-PCR.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD
Clinical Geneticist
[redacted date]
